name: Collapsible
description: Disclosure row with a bold label trigger and an expandable content region. Used inside cards (e.g. MerchCard) to reveal a feature list.

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger label text (Figma TEXT prop on .label)

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the content region starts expanded (Figma State variant)

props.name: content
props.description: Slotted content shown when open (Figma .content SLOT prop)

notes: Figma binds root itemSpacing to s2a/spacing/sm (12) when open and s2a/spacing/2xs (4) when closed; in CSS this is a single margin-top on the content region, which only renders when open — so only the 12px open value applies.
Chevron is an inline SVG (S2 chevron shape) rotated 180deg via CSS on [open], replacing the Figma ChevronDown/ChevronUp instance swap.

Native <details>/<summary> was chosen over button+aria-expanded because the design is a plain disclosure row — the platform element provides the expanded/collapsed semantics and keyboard interaction (Enter/Space) natively.
The chevron SVG carries aria-hidden='true'; the summary's accessible name comes from the label text.
